conventions.usage: mockup.html uses ONLY these values (as CSS custom properties with the same names). Tailwind config (frontend-structure.json) maps them 1:1. The starred core tokens are mandated by the project brief and must never be changed; the rest are documented extensions needed to build real screens.
conventions.hoverFormula: hover = base colour with each RGB channel multiplied by 0.92 (the 'darken 8%' interaction rule). Precomputed below so UI and mockup use identical hexes.

color._note: primary/error/text are the mandated palette (*). success/warning power toasts and order-status badges; neutrals power borders, alt surfaces, disabled and focus states.

spacing._note: All margins/paddings/gaps are multiples of these three steps.

radius._note: pill is used only for Badge and the cart counter.

font._note: h2/h3/small are extensions on the same scale; body and h1 are mandated.

breakpoints._note: Widths 769–1023px render the Tablet layout (documented assumption, NFR-005). Media queries are mobile-first: base = Mobile, @media (min-width: 376px) = Tablet, @media (min-width: 1024px) = Desktop.

statusBadge._note: Order-status → colour mapping; rationale in state-transitions.md §4. Text colour is the badge colour on a 12%-opacity tint of the same colour.
